hero.title: Mauya kuMavingTech High School
hero.subtitle: Apo pfungwa dzechidiki dzinorerwa kuva vatungamiri, vagadziri nevashanduri veramangwana.

learning.title: Kudzidza Kunotanga Nesu
learning.p1: KuMavingTech High School, tinopa nzvimbo inotsigira uye inokurudzira vadzidzi kuti vadzidze, vakure uye vabudirire. Rudo rwedu rwedzidzo runopfuura mhedzisiro yakanaka — tinovaka vafungi vane chivimbo, vanogadzira, vakagadzirira ramangwana.
learning.p2: Kubva kuForm 1 kusvika kuA Level, vadzidzi vedu vanobuda vaine hunhu, tsika neunyanzvi hwekushandura nyika.

director.title: Kubva Padesk RaHeadmaster
director.quote: KuMavingTech High School, tinotenda kuti mudzidzi wose ane chipo chakakosha. Basa redu nderekurera chipo ichocho netsika, kutenda, kushanda nesimba nerudo rwekuziva.
director.body: Mauya munharaunda yedu yechikoro. Pamwe chete nevadzidzisi vedu vakazvipira, vabereki vanotsigira nevadzidzi vane tariro, tinovaka chikoro apo hunyanzvi hwedzidzo hunofamba pamwe nehunhu hwakasimba.

curriculum.title: Ongororo yeKarikulamu
curriculum.intro: MavingTech inopa vadzidzi vose karikulamu yakafara uye yakaenzana inovagadzirira upenyu hwavo.

math.title: Masvomhu
math.desc: Kuvaka hwaro hwakasimba hwekuongorora nekugadzirisa matambudziko chaiwo.

lit.title: Hunyanzvi neMitauro
lit.desc: Kuvaka kutaura, kunzwisisa uye rudo rwekuverenga nekunyora.

sci.title: Sayenzi
sci.desc: Kudzidza nemibvunzo muphysics, chemistry nebiology mumaraboratari azvino.

arts.title: Hunyanzvi Hwekuona
arts.desc: Masitudiyo ekugadzira apo vadzidzi vanoongorora kudhirowa, kupenda nedhizaini.

perf.title: Hunyanzvi Hwekuita
perf.desc: Zvirongwa zvemimhanzi, mitambo nekutamba zvinovaka chivimbo.

cta.title: Tanga Rwendo Rwako Nesu
cta.desc: Pinda munharaunda yakazvipira kuhunyanzvi hwedzidzo, hunhu nekugadzira. Kunyoresa kwakavhurwa.

about.title: Nezve MavingTech
about.subtitle: Makore ekurera pfungwa dzechidiki kuti dzive vatungamiri vane chivimbo nevagadziri.
about.history1: MavingTech High School, chikoro chine mukurumbira, chakavambwa muna Ndira 1927 sechikoro chekutanga chetekinoroji munyika.
about.history2: Chikoro chakawana chinzvimbo chesekondari muna 1931 uye chakatamira kunzvimbo yacho yazvino muna 1953. Chakatumidzwa zita rekuti MavingTech Technical High School musi wa19 Nyamavhuvhu 1961, chikazopfupikiswa kuva MavingTech High School muna 1974.
about.history3: Nhasi, nevadzidzi vanopfuura mazana masere, tinoenderera nenhaka yehunyanzvi mudzidzo nemitambo.
